jobs.title: Product Director, AI Service Operations
jobs.description:
Product Director, AI Service Operations

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed Product Director to help make Navan known for personalized concierge service at scale. You will be directly responsible for Navan’s topline and bottomline by evolving our AI booking tools and cost of operations by products across Ava—Navan’s customer-facing AI service agent—consultant tools, and automation for travel and expense operation, as well as crisis management products.

You will continue to evolve Ava so it recognizes each customer’s context, anticipates needs, takes action, and brings in the right consultant at the right moment. You will also give consultants the context and tools to deliver the same personal, effortless experience.

This role connects product, operations, and customer experience. You will set the vision, product strategy and roadmap and partner with engineering, design, data, and operations to create one seamless service experience across Ava, consultants, and automation.

What You'll Do:

- Work with sales, consulting, and support teams to design new AI-based tools and automation to optimize efficiency.

- Manage a team of 2+ Product managers

- Own the overall strategy and roadmap for Ava, consultant tools, crisis management and operations automation.

- Set the product standard for personalized, proactive service across Ava and consultant-led support.

- Expand the customer needs Ava can resolve while preserving quality and knowing when a consultant should step in.

- Partner across Travel, Expense, engineering, design, data, and operations to embed Ava throughout the customer journey and make consultant handoffs seamless.

- Give consultants the customer history, preferences, and conversation context they need to resolve issues quickly and personalize every interaction.

- Measure customer satisfaction, resolution, personalization, handoff quality, productivity, accuracy, cost, and reliability. Use customer and consultant feedback to improve results.

-

What We're Looking For:

- Experience: 10+ years in product management, with experience leading teams and customer-facing products at scale. A background in AI, customer service, travel, expense, marketplaces, or enterprise software is preferred.

- Customer-Facing AI: Has built chatbots, assistants, or automation used directly by customers, with strong judgment about personalization and when a human should step in.

- Product Judgment: Turns complex systems and customer context into simple, personal, and trustworthy experiences.

- Operational Problem-Solving: Turns customer and consultant pain points into scalable products, tools, and processes.

- Customer Focus: Learns directly from customers and consultants and turns those insights into experiences that feel personal, proactive, and effortless.

- Analytical and Technical Skills: Uses data, feedback, and testing to make decisions and partners effectively with engineering on integrations, performance, and reliability.

- Communication: Aligns cross-functional teams, frontline stakeholders, and executives around a clear direction.

- Leadership: Makes clear decisions and balances customer value, quality, risk, and cost.

- P&L Ownership: Accountable for service offering P&L

jobs.title: Product Director, Service Operations
jobs.description:
Navan is the all-in-one travel and expense management platform that powers the world’s leading businesses. By combining cutting-edge technology, corporate cards, and a modern traveler experience, Navan is disrupting traditional enterprise T&E pacing past  $900M+ in revenue with over $9B in Gross Booking Volume .

At Navan, we believe world-class technology should empower world-class human service. We are committed to building an AI-first service ecosystem where frontline travel consultants and intelligent automation work in tandem to deliver a true 5-star concierge experience at scale.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a sharp, user-obsessed, and high-slope Senior Product Director, Service Operations to serve as the core product counterpart to our engineering and operational leadership.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end product vision for internal tools, consultant workflows, crisis management, and the next-generation AI intelligence layer powering our global service operations. A key focus of your mandate will be expanding and rebranding our core internal platform.
Taking our AI travel assistant, Ava , to the next level ("Ava for Consultants") to automate complex travel workflows, improve agent productivity, and elevate customer experience.

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role at the intersection of product, AI, operations, and customer experience. You will manage and mentor product managers, partner deeply with cross-functional teams across our global hubs, and build toward a future with expanding scope across service technology, operational systems, and potential engineering leadership.

What You’ll Do

-
Own the Service Ops Strategy: Drive the end-to-end product strategy for internal tools, agent workflows, AI copilots, crisis management systems, and service quality infrastructure.

-
Evolve Internal AI Architecture: Lead the product evolution of Ava into an intelligent, AI-driven copilot for frontline travel consultants—enabling faster resolutions, automated policy enforcement, and personalized support across complex travel and expense scenarios.

-
Partner Cross-Functionally & Globally: Collaborate deeply with engineering, frontline operations, design, data, and training teams across our global hubs ( London, Tel Aviv, Portugal, India, and the US ).

-
Elevate the Frontline Experience: Build intuitive tools that reduce cognitive load for agents, accelerate onboarding ramp times, and guide decision-making during high-pressure moments.

-
Define & Track Core Success Metrics: Own KPIs aligned with operational efficiency, customer satisfaction (CSAT), agent productivity, first-contact resolution (FCR), automation rates, and platform reliability.

-
Build & Scale Product Ops: Consolidate and mentor existing PM talent while helping establish a world-class Product Operations function to bridge frontline insights with product development.

What We’re Looking For

-
Product Leadership & High Slope: 8–10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of driving massive impact in complex operational environments, support platforms, internal tools, enterprise SaaS, or marketplace platforms. (Prior team management preferred, but high-impact ICs with strong leadership trajectory will be evaluated).

-
AI Product Instincts: Hands-on experience or deep technical intuition for building AI-powered tools, copilots, workflow automation, knowledge platforms, or agentic intelligence.

-
Operational Depth: A genuine love for untangling fragmented, complex operational problems and translating frontline pain points into elegant, scalable software.

-
Technical Acumen: Ability to collaborate closely with engineering leaders on platform architecture, integrations, APIs, and workflow systems.

-
Global Mobility & Collaboration: Willingness to travel periodically to key engineering and operational hubs ( Tel Aviv, Portugal, India, US ) and work collaboratively out of our London office .

-
High Ownership & Growth Mindset: A builder who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and is excited by ambiguity and expanding scope.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Book with AI
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the future of business travel through Book with AI. You will own the product across Hotels, Rental Cars, and Rail, while serving as the day-to-day product lead for the team and making complex bookings feel as natural, trustworthy, and seamless as working with an expert travel agent.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Book with AI product end to end across Hotels, Rental Cars, and Rail. Your mission is to make booking complex business travel feel as natural as working with an expert travel agent - while making sure the agent is accurate, policy-aware, transparent, and reliable enough for real transactions.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role. You’ll lead day-to-day execution across the entire traveler journey - from the initial request through search, comparison, booking, post-booking support, and recovery when things go wrong, partnering closely with engineering, design, applied AI/ML, data, travel domain experts, operations, and other product teams.

You’ll shape the conversational and user-interface experiences that power Book with AI, helping travelers express their needs, evaluate trade-offs, make confident decisions, and complete bookings with less effort. You’ll stay close to the customer experience by reviewing real conversations, leading bug bashes, interpreting evaluation results, identifying patterns in user feedback, and ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-impact opportunities.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, learns quickly, and is energized by AI-native products. They create clarity and momentum without waiting for perfect information, roll up their sleeves, and drive work through uncertainty and chaos.

What You'll Do

- Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Book with AI across Hotels, Rental Cars, and Rail.

- Own the full Book with AI journey: intent understanding, search, ranking and recommendations, policy and personalization, comparison, contract, checkout, booking, and post-booking support.

- Define a coherent cross-LOB experience for users who want to plan and book multiple parts of a trip, including clear sequencing, handoffs, and expectations.

- Improve the product's key outcomes, including successful booking completion, conversion, time to book, user effort, CSAT, trust, and repeat usage.

- Lead experimentation across conversational flows, recommendations, search and booking surfaces, using clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.

- Partner with AI, data, and engineering teams to improve intent understanding, ranking, recommendations, personalization, tool orchestration, and the use of conversational and UI-based experiences.

- Establish a strong product feedback loop, such as organizing and prioritizing bug bash findings, investigate production conversations, connect issues to root causes, and ensure fixes are validated before and after release.

- Define meaningful goals and evaluation criteria for AI behavior, including task completion, factual accuracy, policy compliance, correct tool and UI usage, response quality, latency, and safe recovery from failures.

- Align stakeholders across product, engineering, design, ML, data, travel operations, support, and adjacent Navan teams.

- Communicate product decisions, tradeoffs, status, risks, and learnings clearly to leadership and the broader organization.

- Represent the customer in every discussion and ensure that the AI is transparent about limitations, unsupported requests, changing prices, availability, and booking status.

What We're Looking For

- 4+ years of experience in product management, with a track record of owning and shipping customer-facing products.

- Experience owning a complex product or product area end to end, including strategy, discovery, prioritization, execution, launch, and measurement.

- Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer value, business impact, technical complexity, reliability, and speed.

- Experience improving measurable product outcomes such as conversion, task completion, engagement, retention, or customer satisfaction.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create alignment with leadership, collaborate across diverse stakeholders, and communicate effectively with customers.

- A data-informed approach to product decisions, combined with strong qualitative judgment and customer empathy.

- Curiosity about AI products and the ability to reason about probabilistic systems, failure modes, evaluation, guardrails, and human trust.

- A practical, ownership-oriented mindset: you find the problem, clarify it, bring the right people together, and drive it through resolution.

Nice to hav e

- Experience building AI assistants, conversational products, recommendation systems, search experiences, or agentic workflows.

- Experience defining or using LLM evaluations, quality rubrics, production monitoring, or experimentation frameworks.

How you will make an impac t

In your first months, you will build a deep understanding of the Book with AI experience and its users, establish a clear view of the highest-impact opportunities across Hotels, Cars, and Rail, and create a focused execution rhythm with the team. You will bring structure to the product backlog, quality loop, and roadmap so the team can consistently focus on the problems that matter most.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Product Marketing Manager to drive the strategic direction and positioning for our products, with a primary focus on our travel product. In this role, you will be the bridge between product, sales, and marketing, ensuring that our capabilities are effectively positioned, communicated, and understood by prospects and customers. You will be responsible for developing compelling messaging, translating new product capabilities into impactful value propositions, and creating marketing strategies that fuel growth and engagement.

If you are passionate about travel, AI, and tech, have a knack for storytelling, and thrive at the intersection of product and GTM, we’d love to have you on board.

What You’ll Do

- Work with Product and Sales to define target audiences and craft clear, compelling messaging and positioning that differentiates Navan’s capabilities in the market.

- Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market plans for new and existing products, ensuring successful adoption and engagement.

- Conduct market research to understand customer needs, competitive landscapes, and industry trends to inform product development and marketing strategies.

- Partner with Enablement and Field teams to develop tools, training, and resources that enhance their ability to sell Navan’s products effectively.

- Create a variety of marketing materials, including product collateral, case studies, white papers, and blog posts that highlight the value of Navan’s capabilities. Ensure consistency across all touchpoints.

- Collaborate with the broader marketing team to design and execute marketing campaigns that drive product awareness, lead generation, and customer retention.

- Monitor and report on the effectiveness of product marketing initiatives, using data to optimize strategies and achieve business goals.

- Work closely with product management, sales, customer success, and other teams to align on product strategy and execution.

What We’re Looking For

- 6+ years of product marketing experience, preferably within AI, travel, SaaS, and/or tech, with a track record of launching and growing B2B products.

- Demonstrated ability to use AI across product marketing workflows, including research, messaging development, content creation, launch planning, and operational optimization, to improve speed, quality, and impact.

- Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders effectively, including across multiple time zones.

- Strong strategic and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex product features into customer benefits and compelling marketing messages.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a talent for storytelling and creating engaging content. The ability to write well is essential.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience with market research and competitive analysis to inform strategic planning.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Navan Premier
jobs.description:
Navan is seeking a dynamic and strategic Product Marketing Manager to define and scale the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Navan Premier - our high-touch offering combining cutting-edge travel and AI technology with white-glove human service. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Marketing, acting as the bridge that ensures our capabilities are effectively positioned, communicated, and understood by prospects and clients alike.

You will translate Premier’s unique value proposition into clear messaging, adoption communications, vertical sales plays, client-facing collateral, pricing narratives, and sales enablement. You will play a pivotal role in clients adopting Navan Premier, supporting existing customer communications while building a repeatable growth engine for net-new Premier business. This is a high-visibility, highly cross-functional role for someone who thrives at moving seamlessly between strategy and execution.

Core Responsibilities

As Premier PMM you’ll contribute to three objectives:

- Ensure Seamless Migration: Lead product marketing activity that supports upsells and adoption to Navan Premier within our existing client base, increasing trust, service quality, and program momentum.

- Drive Net-New Growth: Support Navan Sales to win more of the right target clients by establishing clear differentiation and value metrics for Premier.

- Ongoing Client Engagement: Support client success teams at Navan in developing dedicated messaging and communications for ongoing adoption and programme success.

What You'll Do

- Positioning & Messaging: Work with Product and Sales to define target audiences and craft compelling positioning that differentiates Navan Premier in the market.

- Value Proposition & Value Messaging: Articulate Premier’s unique value proposition and ROI so clients clearly understand why Premier is unique to Navan.

- Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive GTM plans for new capabilities and service enhancements to drive product adoption and engagement for Navan Premier.

- Sales Enablement: Partner with Enablement and Field teams to produce pitch decks, playbooks, battlecards, and training materials that empower Sales to sell Premier with confidence in a simple and highly differentiated way.

- Content & Collateral: Produce high-impact product collateral for prospects and customers, independently and in partnership with the Content team.

- Market Research & Intelligence: Conduct customer research, competitive analyses, and industry benchmarking to inform product roadmaps and strategic narrative alignment for high-touch service requirement sectors.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, Operations, and Sales to inform integrated campaigns that support retention and pipeline growth.

- Performance Analysis: Track, report on, and optimize product marketing initiatives using performance data to achieve target business outcomes.

- Migration Communications: Craft coherent, transparent, and reassuring migration communications that protect client trust during transitions.

- Pricing & Packaging Narratives: Align pricing narratives and structures to support high-touch service delivery while protecting profitability and margins.

- Vertical GTM Frameworks: Establish repeatable go-to-market execution frameworks across priority high-touch verticals rather than relying on bespoke storytelling.

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 8+ years of product marketing experience, preferably within travel tech, corporate travel, SaaS, or high-touch B2B solutions and service sectors, with a proven track record of product launches and GTM growth.

- AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI across product marketing workflows (research, messaging, content generation, and launch planning) to boost speed, quality, and scale.

- Storytelling & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a flair for crafting clear narratives out of complex product and service models.

- Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical ability to translate complex technology features and high-touch service offerings into clear, business-driven customer benefits.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across multiple functions and time zones.

- Execution & Project Management: Highly organized with an ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Navan, “It’s all about the user. All of them.” We’re passionate about creating seamless, personalized travel experiences for business travelers around the globe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Hotels for our Navan Edge team in Tel Aviv . Your mission is to build the next generation of hotel booking: a high-converting, personalized agentic experience that helps frequent business travelers find and book the right hotel with less effort.
You won’t just own hotel data or funnel metrics; you’ll design the intelligent conversation hotel experience behind Navan Edge, where AI understands traveler intent, applies personal preferences, compares options, explains trade-offs, and guides users from search to booking with confidence.

What You’ll Do:

* Own the Hotels Product Experience: Lead the full hotel journey, from destination intent and search to hotel details, room selection, checkout, confirmation, and post-booking engagement.
* Design Agentic Hotel Experiences: Build AI-driven workflows that help users search, compare, decide, and book hotels through a mix of conversation, recommendations, proactive suggestions, and UI components.
* Drive Hotel Funnel Conversion: Identify friction points across the hotel funnel and define the roadmap to improve search-to-booking, availability-to-checkout, checkout completion, and repeat booking rates.
* Improve Search, Ranking, and Personalization: Partner with AI, data, and engineering teams to improve hotel ranking, filters, recommendations, availability logic, and “why this hotel” explanations based on traveler intent, loyalty, price, amenities, business schedule, and past preferences.
* Lead Experimentation: Design and run A/B tests across search results, hotel detail pages, room selection, checkout, rewards messaging, onboarding flows, and AI-assisted booking experiences.
* Connect Hotels to the Full Trip Experience: Work across flights, restaurants, itinerary, calendar, Gmail sync, and proactive travel use cases to make hotels feel like part of one seamless business travel journey.

What We’re Looking For:

* 5+ Years of PM Experience: Proven experience building consumer, marketplace, travel, ecommerce, AI, or SaaS products.
* Hotels Product Experience: Experience building hotel, lodging, travel marketplace, OTA, or business travel products is strongly preferred.
* Agentic Product Thinking: You understand how AI can move beyond static recommendations into guided decision-making, autonomous workflows, proactive suggestions, and personalized task completion.
* Strong Funnel Conversion Skills: Deep understanding of conversion optimization, user drop-off analysis, checkout flows, experimentation, and growth metrics.
* Data-Driven Product Thinking: You are comfortable with funnel dashboards, cohort analysis, A/B testing, behavioral analytics, and turning insights into roadmap decisions.
* Strong Product Taste: You know what a great hotel shopping experience should feel like: fast, clear, trustworthy, personalized, and easy to complete.
* Commercial Instincts: You understand how hotel product decisions affect conversion, margin, supplier performance, loyalty, and repeat usage.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: You can align design, engineering, AI, data, marketing, operations, and business stakeholders around a clear product strategy.
* The Traveler’s Heart: You understand the messy reality of business travel and want to make hotel booking feel effortless, reliable, and rewarding.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments
jobs.description:
Navan is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and execution of our Payments platform, the critical infrastructure that powers billions of dollars in transaction volume for thousands of companies worldwide.

This role sits at the intersection of product innovation, financial infrastructure, and global expansion, defining how Navan moves money, manages relationships with banking and payment partners, and scales our payments capabilities into new markets. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape the future of how businesses manage corporate payments at scale.

What You’ll Do:

- Own the end-to-end experience for Navan Expense payments and payouts, from bank account configuration to payment routing, settlement, and reconciliation. You’ll build and manage intelligent systems that optimize for speed, reliability, cost, and compliance across multiple payment rails.

- Build strategic relationships and integrations with banking partners, payment service providers, and fintech infrastructure companies.

- Lead the expansion of Navan's payments capabilities into new geographies, navigating regulatory and compliance requirements, local banking infrastructure, and currency exchange dynamics.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Design, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver high-impact features from conception through launch.

- Maintain a prioritized roadmap focused on maximizing customer value while managing technical complexity and risk.

- Use data and analytics to inform decisions, track success metrics, and continuously optimize payment performance.

What We’re Looking For:

- Minimum 5 years of product management or equivalent experience

- Strong product taste, judgement, and design thinking

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams toward ambitious goals with agency and urgency.

- AI fluency, using AI tools to accelerate your workflows and drive impact

- Strong systems thinking to design scalable infrastructure that supports both current needs and future growth

Preferred Experience:

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate and strategic product leader with a deep understanding of B2B software and platform services? We are seeking a foundational leader to own and drive the strategy for several critical modules that anchor our global product. You will be responsible for creating a scalable platform that seamlessly integrates with external systems, empowers our customers with valuable data insights, and delivers a truly inclusive experience through localization and accessibility.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work with global teams across different time zones and cultures, cutting through complexity to bring clarity and direction. If you are passionate about building robust, technical products that form the bedrock of a successful enterprise solution, this is your chance to make a significant impact on our hyper-growth trajectory.

What You’ll Do:

- Lead the Product Strategy and Vision: Own and develop the product strategy and roadmap for platform & core services. These include, and not limited to integrations, data services, identity, admin functionalities.

- Empower Data-Driven Decisions: Spearhead the product strategy for our data services. This involves defining how we collect, organize, and store application data, and then exposing it through valuable, insightful reports and dashboards for customers and internal stakeholders.

- Be a Hands-On Leader: Partner closely with world-class engineers, designers, and data analysts to define, design, build, launch, and measure new products and features. You will be accountable for the outcomes and impact of your modules.

- Communicate with Clarity: Build influence across the organization through powerful storytelling, a deep understanding of data, and logical, concise communication. You will be an expert at cutting through the noise to bring clarity and direction to complex, global initiatives.

- Work Globally: Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams located in different regions and time zones to ensure alignment on product goals and delivery.

What We’re Looking For:

- Experience: You have 8+ years of experience in product management, with a clear understanding of how different products within a portfolio work together to drive business outcomes.

- Technical Acumen: You are a technically-minded product manager with a solid understanding of APIs, data pipelines, backend services, and a track record of working on complex platform products.

- Domain Knowledge: You have experience managing product strategy for B2B software and are comfortable with concepts related to data management, system integrations, and multi-tenant SaaS architectures.

- Exceptional Judgment: You demonstrate excellent judgment in identifying which problems to solve, how to create value, and in designing elegant solutions.

- Clear Communicator: You are proactive, persistent, and creative in confronting challenges. You have a track record of partnering with others to get things done and can engender trust and respect among your colleagues through your communication style.

- Hands-On Mentality: You thrive on an empowered product team and understand the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and delivery. You feel strong accountability for outcomes and understand the role of your team’s outputs in achieving them.

- Global Mindset: You are passionate about building products for a global user base and understand the importance of inclusion and diversity in your team and your product design.
